verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a terminal emulator, since some terminals ship one, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any AI assistant or task delegation in Alacritty. The docs cover vi mode, search, hints, multi-window, IPC and config, and the README stresses a minimal feature set.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
